sloka: युद्ध्यमानस्य रक्षोभिस्तव तैः क्रूरकर्मभिः ।प्रपतेयं हि ते पृष्ठाद् भयार्ता कपिसत्तम ।। ५.३७.५०।।।।
transliteration: yuddhyamānasya rakṣobhistava taiḥ krūrakarmabhiḥ ।prapateyaṁ hi te pṛṣṭhād bhayārtā kapisattama ।। 5.37.50।।।।

translations.english: "The demons are in large number and they will be armed with weapons. You are unarmed. How can you fight and protect me?
